report.summary: Food resource options for patient P-D005 (age 34, commercial Employer HMO, home tract 17031241400). Recent CMS AHC screener (2026-10-22) was negative for food insecurity (food_worry and food_ran_out both "never_true"); no transportation barrier reported. Tract is not USDA low-income/low-access and has strong transit access (60 stops within 800m). Four community food options identified with eligibility checks where possible; none require the patient's commercial insurance.
